00105              MOVE 'READY  ' TO GAME-STATE.

00117              MOVE REQ-LEVEL TO AI-LEVEL.
00118              MOVE REQ-COUNT TO GHOST-COUNT.
00119          DO-INIT.
00120              MOVE 'LOAD' TO M-OP.

00122              MOVE PLAYER-X TO M-X.

00124              MOVE 'CLR ' TO M-OP.

00132              MOVE M-COUNT TO PELLETS-LEFT.
00133          RESET-GHOST.

00135              MOVE GS-Y (WS-G) TO GH-Y (WS-G).

00138              MOVE GH-X (WS-G) TO M-X.
00139              MOVE GH-Y (WS-G) TO M-Y.
00140              MOVE 'CLR ' TO M-OP.
00141              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00142          DO-QUIT.

00144              MOVE 'QUIT   ' TO GAME-STATE.
00145          DO-MOVE.
00146              MOVE REQ-CHAR TO LAST-CMD.
00147              MOVE PLAYER-X TO NEW-X.
00148              MOVE PLAYER-Y TO NEW-Y.

00150              PERFORM AIM-MOVE THRU AIM-MOVE-EXIT.
00151              ADD 1 TO TICK-COUNT.
00152              MOVE NEW-X TO M-X.
00153              MOVE NEW-Y TO M-Y.
00154              MOVE 'WALL' TO M-OP.
00155              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00156              IF M-FLAG = 1
00157                  MOVE 'BLOCKED' TO LAST-RESULT
00158              ELSE
00159                  MOVE NEW-X TO PLAYER-X
00160                  MOVE NEW-Y TO PLAYER-Y
00161                  PERFORM EAT-PELLET THRU EAT-PELLET-EXIT.
00162              PERFORM ROUND-END THRU ROUND-END-EXIT.
00163              PERFORM SET-STATE THRU SET-STATE-EXIT.
00164          AIM-MOVE.
00165              IF REQ-DIR = 'U'
00166                  SUBTRACT 1 FROM NEW-Y
00167              ELSE IF REQ-DIR = 'D'
00168                  ADD 1 TO NEW-Y   4


00169              ELSE IF REQ-DIR = 'L'

00171              ELSE IF REQ-DIR = 'R'
00172                  ADD 1 TO NEW-X.

00190              IF F-HIT = 0 AND F-WON = 0 AND AI-LEVEL > 0

00192                  PERFORM CHECK-HIT THRU CHECK-HIT-EXIT.
00193              IF F-HIT = 1
00194                  PERFORM LOSE-LIFE THRU LOSE-LIFE-EXIT.
00195          ROUND-END-EXIT.
00196              EXIT.
00197          CHECK-HIT.

00200          CHECK-HIT-EXIT.
00201              EXIT.
00202          HIT-TEST.
00203              IF GH-X (WS-G) = PLAYER-X AND GH-Y (WS-G) = PLAYER-Y
00204                  MOVE 1 TO F-HIT.
00205          HIT-TEST-EXIT.
00206              EXIT.
00207          LOSE-LIFE.
00208              MOVE 0 TO F-WON.
00209              SUBTRACT 1 FROM LIVES.
00210              IF LIVES = 0
00211                  MOVE 1 TO F-LOST
00212                  MOVE 'LOST   ' TO LAST-RESULT
00213              ELSE
00214                  MOVE 'DIED   ' TO LAST-RESULT
00215                  MOVE 2 TO PLAYER-X
00216                  MOVE 2 TO PLAYER-Y
00217                  PERFORM RESET-GHOST VARYING WS-G FROM 1 BY 1
00218                      UNTIL WS-G > GHOST-COUNT

00220                      MOVE 1 TO F-WON.
00221          LOSE-LIFE-EXIT.
00222              EXIT.

00224              IF F-LOST = 1
00225                  MOVE 'LOST   ' TO GAME-STATE   5

00065          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00066          MAIN-PARA.
00067              MOVE 0 TO M-FLAG.
00068              IF M-OP = 'LOAD'
00069                  MOVE MAP-DATA TO MAP-AREA
00070              ELSE IF M-OP = 'WALL'
00071                  PERFORM DO-WALL THRU DO-WALL-EXIT
00072              ELSE IF M-OP = 'CLR '
00073                  MOVE ' ' TO MAP-CELL (M-Y M-X)
00074              ELSE IF M-OP = 'EAT '
00075                  PERFORM DO-EAT THRU DO-EAT-EXIT
00076              ELSE IF M-OP = 'CNT '
00077                  PERFORM DO-COUNT.
00078              GOBACK.
00079          DO-WALL.
00080              IF M-X < 1 OR M-X > 20 OR M-Y < 1 OR M-Y > 10
00081                  MOVE 1 TO M-FLAG
00082              ELSE IF MAP-CELL (M-Y M-X) = '#'
00083                  MOVE 1 TO M-FLAG.
00084          DO-WALL-EXIT.
00085              EXIT.
00086          DO-EAT.
00087              IF MAP-CELL (M-Y M-X) = '.'
00088                  MOVE ' ' TO MAP-CELL (M-Y M-X)
00089                  MOVE 1 TO M-FLAG.
00090          DO-EAT-EXIT.
00091              EXIT.
00092          DO-COUNT.
00093              MOVE 0 TO M-COUNT.
00094              PERFORM COUNT-ROW VARYING WS-ROW FROM 1 BY 1
00095                  UNTIL WS-ROW > 10.
00096          COUNT-ROW.
00097              PERFORM COUNT-CELL THRU COUNT-CELL-EXIT
00098                  VARYING WS-COL FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-COL > 20.
00099          COUNT-CELL.
00100              IF MAP-CELL (WS-ROW WS-COL) = '.'
00101                  ADD 1 TO M-COUNT.
00102          COUNT-CELL-EXIT.
00103              EXIT.   3

00101              IF M-FLAG = 0

00114              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00115              IF M-FLAG = 0
00116                  MOVE 1 TO CAND-N
00117                  MOVE WS-D TO CAND (1).
00118          TRY-REVERSE-EXIT.
00119              EXIT.
00120          CHOOSE-DIR.
00121              IF AI-LEVEL = 3
00122                  PERFORM PICK-CHASE
00123              ELSE IF AI-LEVEL = 2 AND CAND-N = 1
00124                  MOVE CAND (1) TO WS-D
00125              ELSE
00126                  PERFORM PICK-RANDOM.
00127          CHOOSE-DIR-EXIT.
00128              EXIT.
00129          PICK-RANDOM.
00130              COMPUTE WS-WORK = GHOST-SEED * 75 + 74.
00131              DIVIDE WS-WORK BY 65537 GIVING WS-QUOT
00132                  REMAINDER GHOST-SEED.
00133              DIVIDE GHOST-SEED BY CAND-N GIVING WS-QUOT
00134                  REMAINDER WS-REM.
00135              ADD 1 TO WS-REM.
00136              MOVE CAND (WS-REM) TO WS-D.
00137          PICK-CHASE.
00138              MOVE 999 TO BEST-DIST.
00139              PERFORM CHASE-EVAL THRU CHASE-EVAL-EXIT
00140                  VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > CAND-N.
00141          CHASE-EVAL.
00142              MOVE CAND (WS-J) TO WS-K.
00143              COMPUTE G-NX = GH-X (WS-G) + DIR-DX (WS-K) - 1.
00144              COMPUTE G-NY = GH-Y (WS-G) + DIR-DY (WS-K) - 1.
00145              COMPUTE DIST-X = G-NX - PLAYER-X.
00146              IF DIST-X < 0
00147                  COMPUTE DIST-X = 0 - DIST-X.
00148              COMPUTE DIST-Y = G-NY - PLAYER-Y.
00149              IF DIST-Y < 0
00150                  COMPUTE DIST-Y = 0 - DIST-Y.
00151              COMPUTE DIST-T = DIST-X + DIST-Y.
00152              IF DIST-T < BEST-DIST
00153                  MOVE DIST-T TO BEST-DIST
00154                  MOVE WS-K TO WS-D.
00155          CHASE-EVAL-EXIT.
00156              EXIT.
00157          STEP-GHOST.
00158              COMPUTE GH-X (WS-G) = GH-X (WS-G) + DIR-DX (WS-D) - 1.
00159              COMPUTE GH-Y (WS-G) = GH-Y (WS-G) + DIR-DY (WS-D) - 1.
00160              MOVE WS-D TO GH-DIR (WS-G).   4

00256          01  PAC-DS COPY PACDS.
00257 C       * 3270 DATA STREAM BUFFER PASSED FROM PACSCR TO PACPLAT (SEND).
00258 C        01  PAC-DS.
00259 C            05  DS-LEN                PIC S9(4) COMP.
00260 C            05  DS-BUF.
00261 C                10  DS-BYTE           PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.

00263          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAC-STATE PAC-REQ PAC-DS.
00264          MAIN-PARA.
00265              IF TAB-OK = 0
00266                  PERFORM INIT-TAB.
00267              IF REQ-OP = 'INVL'
00268                  MOVE 1 TO MSG-ON
00269                  MOVE REQ-CHAR TO INV-CHAR
00270              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'PRMT'
00271                  PERFORM DO-PRMT THRU DO-PRMT-EXIT
00272              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'TICK'
00273                  PERFORM DO-TICK THRU DO-TICK-EXIT
00274              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'FULL'
00275                  PERFORM DO-FULL THRU DO-FULL-EXIT.
00276              GOBACK.
00277          DO-PRMT.
00278              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00279              MOVE 'F' TO DS-KIND.
00280              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00281              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y'
00282                  PERFORM TOGGLE-VIS.   6


00283              PERFORM SET-FACE.
00284              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00285              IF REQ-REDRAW = 'P'
00286                  PERFORM PRMT-VS
00287              ELSE
00288                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00289              MOVE MSG-ON TO MSG-LAST.
00290              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00291          DO-PRMT-EXIT.
00292              EXIT.
00293          PRMT-VS.
00294         * VIRTUAL IMAGE FIRST; FULL SCREEN WHEN THE TERMINAL HAS NOTHING
00295         * KNOWN (FIRST SCREEN) OR THE LAST INPUT WAS A REDRAW REQUEST.
00296              PERFORM BUILD-VS.
00297              IF PREV-OK = 1 AND REQ-KIND NOT = 'RDR'
00298                  PERFORM BUILD-PARTIAL.
00299              IF PREV-OK = 0 OR REQ-KIND = 'RDR'
00300                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00301              PERFORM KEEP-VS.
00302          DO-FULL.
00303              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00304              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00305              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00306              MOVE MSG-LAST TO MSG-ON.
00307              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00308              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00309              MOVE 0 TO PREV-OK.
00310          DO-FULL-EXIT.
00311              EXIT.
00312          DO-TICK.
00313              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00314              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND REQ-REDRAW = 'P' AND PREV-OK = 1
00315                  PERFORM TICK-BUILD.
00316          DO-TICK-EXIT.
00317              EXIT.
00318          INIT-HI.
00319              MOVE 0 TO WS-HP WS-HG WS-HE WS-HN WS-HW.
00320              IF REQ-HILITE = 'Y'
00321                  MOVE HI-WALL TO WS-HW
00322                  MOVE HI-PLAYER TO WS-HP
00323                  MOVE HI-GHOST TO WS-HG
00324                  MOVE HI-ERROR TO WS-HE
00325                  MOVE HI-INPUT TO WS-HN.
00326              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00327          TOGGLE-VIS.
00328              IF VIS = 1
00329                  MOVE 0 TO VIS
00330              ELSE
00331                  MOVE 1 TO VIS.
00332              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00333          SET-GLYPHS.
00334              MOVE 'P' TO WS-GP.
00335              MOVE 'G' TO WS-GG.
00336              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND VIS = 0
00337                  MOVE GLY-PLAYER-1 TO WS-GP
00338                  MOVE GLY-GHOST-1 TO WS-GG.
00339              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND VIS = 1   7


00340                  MOVE GLY-PLAYER-2 TO WS-GP
00341                  MOVE GLY-GHOST-2 TO WS-GG.
00342              IF REQ-GLYPHS = 'G'
00343                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS-G.
00344              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00345          SET-GLYPHS-G.
00346         * MVS-G4 GRAPHIC SPRITES: OPEN MOUTH FACING / GHOST, OR (SECOND
00347         * ANIMATION FRAME) CLOSED MOUTH / GHOST WITH THE EYE.
00348              MOVE X-GPR TO WS-GP.
00349              IF WS-FACE = 'L'
00350                  MOVE X-GPL TO WS-GP.
00351              MOVE X-GG1 TO WS-GG.
00352              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND VIS = 1
00353                  MOVE X-GPC TO WS-GP
00354                  MOVE X-GG2 TO WS-GG.
00355              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00356          SET-FACE.
00357         * PAC-MAN FACES THE LAST HORIZONTAL MOVE THAT WAS NOT BLOCKED;
00358         * VERTICAL MOVES, BUMPS AND INVALID INPUT KEEP THE FACING.
00359              IF (LAST-CMD = 'L' OR LAST-CMD = 'l')
00360                                AND LAST-RESULT NOT = 'BLOCKED'
00361                  MOVE 'L' TO WS-FACE.
00362              IF (LAST-CMD = 'R' OR LAST-CMD = 'r')
00363                                AND LAST-RESULT NOT = 'BLOCKED'
00364                  MOVE 'R' TO WS-FACE.
00365              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00366          INIT-TAB.
00367              MOVE PEL-G TO BW-N.
00368              MOVE BW-L TO X-PEL-G.
00369              MOVE PEL-B TO BW-N.
00370              MOVE BW-L TO X-PEL-B.
00371              MOVE GPL-RIGHT TO BW-N.
00372              MOVE BW-L TO X-GPR.
00373              MOVE GPL-LEFT TO BW-N.
00374              MOVE BW-L TO X-GPL.
00375              MOVE GPL-CLOSED TO BW-N.
00376              MOVE BW-L TO X-GPC.
00377              MOVE GGH-1 TO BW-N.
00378              MOVE BW-L TO X-GG1.
00379              MOVE GGH-2 TO BW-N.
00380              MOVE BW-L TO X-GG2.
00381              MOVE 1 TO TAB-OK.
00382          BUILD-VS.
00383              MOVE SPACES TO CU-CH-G.
00384              MOVE ALL '0' TO CU-CO-G.
00385              MOVE ALL '0' TO CU-HI-G.
00386              MOVE ALL '0' TO CU-CS-G.
00387              MOVE 1 TO VS-MODE.
00388              PERFORM COMPOSE-BODY.
00389              MOVE 0 TO VS-MODE.
00390          KEEP-VS.
00391              MOVE VS-CUR TO VS-PREV.
00392              MOVE 1 TO PREV-OK.
00393          BUILD-PARTIAL.
00394         * LOGICAL PARTIAL SCREEN: WCC (RESET MDT, RESTORE KEYBOARD), THE
00395         * CHANGED CELLS, THEN THE EMPTY INPUT FIELD WITH THE CURSOR.
00396              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.   8


00397              MOVE 'P' TO DS-KIND.
00398              MOVE 195 TO WS-BV.
00399              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00400              PERFORM DIFF-ALL.
00401              PERFORM PUT-FIELD-PART.
00402              PERFORM PUT-TAIL.
00403          TICK-BUILD.
00404         * VISUAL TICK: SAME IMAGE, OTHER GLYPH FRAME. WCC WITHOUT RESET
00405         * MDT SO THAT WHAT THE USER IS TYPING IS NOT LOST.
00406              PERFORM TOGGLE-VIS.
00407              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00408              MOVE VS-PREV TO VS-CUR.
00409              PERFORM FLIP-ROW VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 10.
00410              MOVE 'T' TO DS-KIND.
00411              MOVE 194 TO WS-BV.
00412              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00413              PERFORM DIFF-ALL.
00414              IF WS-CHG = 0
00415                  MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00416              IF WS-CHG NOT = 0
00417                  PERFORM PUT-TAIL.
00418              PERFORM KEEP-VS.
00419          FLIP-ROW.
00420              PERFORM FLIP-CELL VARYING WS-COL FROM 1 BY 1
00421                  UNTIL WS-COL > 20.
00422          FLIP-CELL.
00423         * SPRITE CELLS ARE FOUND BY GLYPH; GE CELLS (MVS-G4) BY THE GE
00424         * GLYPHS ONLY, SO A CP310 PELLET IS NEVER TAKEN FOR A SPRITE.
00425              COMPUTE WS-X = (LAY-BOARD-ROW + WS-I - 2) * 80
00426                  + LAY-BOARD-COL + WS-COL - 1.
00427              IF CU-CS (WS-X) = 0 AND (CU-CH (WS-X) = GLY-PLAYER-1
00428                             OR CU-CH (WS-X) = GLY-PLAYER-2)
00429                  MOVE WS-GP TO CU-CH (WS-X).
00430              IF CU-CS (WS-X) = 0 AND (CU-CH (WS-X) = GLY-GHOST-1
00431                             OR CU-CH (WS-X) = GLY-GHOST-2)
00432                  MOVE WS-GG TO CU-CH (WS-X).
00433              IF CU-CS (WS-X) = 1 AND (CU-CH (WS-X) = X-GPR
00434                             OR CU-CH (WS-X) = X-GPL
00435                             OR CU-CH (WS-X) = X-GPC)
00436                  MOVE WS-GP TO CU-CH (WS-X).
00437              IF CU-CS (WS-X) = 1 AND (CU-CH (WS-X) = X-GG1
00438                             OR CU-CH (WS-X) = X-GG2)
00439                  MOVE WS-GG TO CU-CH (WS-X).
00440              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00441          DIFF-ALL.
00442              MOVE 0 TO IN-RUN.
00443              MOVE 0 TO RUN-CO.
00444              MOVE 0 TO RUN-HI.
00445              MOVE 0 TO WS-CHG.
00446              PERFORM DIFF-CELL VARYING WS-X FROM 1 BY 1
00447                  UNTIL WS-X > 1920.
00448          DIFF-CELL.
00449              MOVE 0 TO WS-HV.
00450              IF CU-CH (WS-X) NOT = PV-CH (WS-X)
00451                             OR CU-CO (WS-X) NOT = PV-CO (WS-X)
00452                             OR CU-HI (WS-X) NOT = PV-HI (WS-X)
00453                             OR CU-CS (WS-X) NOT = PV-CS (WS-X)   9


00454                  MOVE 1 TO WS-HV.
00455              IF WS-HV = 0
00456                  MOVE 0 TO IN-RUN.
00457              IF WS-HV = 1
00458                  PERFORM EMIT-CELL.
00459              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00460          EMIT-CELL.
00461              ADD 1 TO WS-CHG.
00462              COMPUTE WS-ADDR = WS-X - 1.
00463              DIVIDE WS-ADDR BY 80 GIVING WS-ROW REMAINDER WS-COL.
00464              ADD 1 TO WS-ROW.
00465              ADD 1 TO WS-COL.
00466              IF IN-RUN = 0 OR WS-COL = 1
00467                  PERFORM PUT-SBA.
00468              MOVE 1 TO IN-RUN.
00469              IF CU-CO (WS-X) NOT = RUN-CO
00470                  MOVE CU-CO (WS-X) TO RUN-CO
00471                  MOVE RUN-CO TO WS-BV
00472                  PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
00473              IF CU-HI (WS-X) NOT = RUN-HI
00474                  MOVE CU-HI (WS-X) TO RUN-HI
00475                  MOVE RUN-HI TO WS-HV
00476                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
00477              IF CU-CS (WS-X) = 1
00478                  MOVE 8 TO WS-BV
00479                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00480              ADD 1 TO DS-LEN.
00481              MOVE CU-CH (WS-X) TO DS-BYTE (DS-LEN).
00482          PUT-FIELD-PART.
00483         * INPUT FIELD DATA BYTE (ROW 18, COL 15): BLANK AGAIN, CURSOR IN.
00484              MOVE LAY-CMD-ROW TO WS-ROW.
00485              MOVE 15 TO WS-COL.
00486              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
00487              MOVE 19 TO WS-BV.
00488              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00489              MOVE PAL-HELP TO WS-BV.
00490              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
00491              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
00492                  MOVE WS-HN TO WS-HV
00493                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
00494              IF WS-HN = 0 AND RUN-HI NOT = 0
00495                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
00496                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
00497              MOVE 64 TO WS-BV.
00498              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00499              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
00500                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
00501                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
00502              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00503          PUT-TAIL.
00504              MOVE 40 TO WS-BV.
00505              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00506              MOVE 0 TO WS-BV.
00507              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00508              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00509          COMPOSE.
00510              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.  10


00511              MOVE 'F' TO DS-KIND.
00512              MOVE 195 TO WS-BV.
00513              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00514              MOVE 1 TO WS-ROW.
00515              MOVE 1 TO WS-COL.
00516              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
00517              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
00518              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00519              MOVE 96 TO WS-BV.
00520              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
00521              PERFORM COMPOSE-BODY.
00522              PERFORM PUT-TAIL.
00523          COMPOSE-BODY.
00524              PERFORM SHOW-STATUS.
00525              IF GHOST-COUNT > 1
00526                  PERFORM SHOW-GHOSTS.
00527              PERFORM SHOW-BOARD-ROW VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
00528                  UNTIL WS-I > 10.
00529              IF MSG-ON = 1
00530                  PERFORM SHOW-MESSAGE.
00531              PERFORM SHOW-COMMAND.
00532              IF VS-MODE = 0
00533                  PERFORM SHOW-FIELD.
00534              PERFORM SHOW-HELP.
00535          SHOW-STATUS.
00536              MOVE TICK-COUNT TO ST-TURN.
00537              MOVE LAST-CMD TO ST-CMD.
00538              MOVE LAST-RESULT TO ST-RESULT.
00539              MOVE PLAYER-X TO ST-X.
00540              MOVE PLAYER-Y TO ST-Y.
00541              MOVE SCORE TO ST-SCORE.
00542              MOVE PELLETS-LEFT TO ST-LEFT.
00543              MOVE GH-X (1) TO ST-GX.
00544              MOVE GH-Y (1) TO ST-GY.
00545              MOVE LIVES TO ST-LIVES.
00546              MOVE GAME-STATE TO ST-STATE.

00001         * PACQRYT : MVS-G4 BATCH TEST DRIVER FOR PACQRY (NOT PART OF THE
00002         * GAME). SYSIN CARDS: COLUMNS 1-8 CASE NAME, 10-73 REPLY BYTES IN
00003         * HEX (UP TO 32 PER CARD); CONSECUTIVE CARDS WITH THE SAME NAME
00004         * ARE ONE REPLY. FOR EVERY REPLY ONE LINE IS PRINTED:
00005         *   QRY NAME     LEN=NNNN C=N H=N GE=N  (COLOUR, HILITE, GE).
00006          IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
00007          PROGRAM-ID. PACQRYT.
00008          ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
00009          CONFIGURATION SECTION.
00010          SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00011          OBJECT-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00012          INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
00013          FILE-CONTROL.
00014              SELECT CARD-FILE ASSIGN TO UT-S-SYSIN.
00015          DATA DIVISION.
00016          FILE SECTION.
00017          FD  CARD-FILE
00018              RECORDING MODE IS F
00019              LABEL RECORDS ARE OMITTED
00020              RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS
00021              DATA RECORD IS CARD-REC.
00022          01  CARD-REC              PIC X(80).
00023          WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
00024          01  WS-CARD.
00025              05  CD-NAME           PIC X(8).
00026              05  FILLER            PIC X.
00027              05  CD-HEX            PIC X OCCURS 64 TIMES.
00028              05  FILLER            PIC X(7).
00029          01  Q-AREA.
00030              05  Q-CH              PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00031          01  Q-LEN                 PIC S9(4) COMP.
00032          01  Q-OUT.
00033              05  QO-COLOUR         PIC 9.
00034              05  QO-HILITE         PIC 9.
00035              05  QO-GE             PIC 9.
00036          01  CUR-NAME              PIC X(8) VALUE SPACES.
00037          01  WS-EOF                PIC 9 VALUE 0.
00038          01  WS-K                  PIC 99.
00039          01  WS-HV                 PIC 99.
00040          01  WS-LV                 PIC 99.
00041          01  WS-D                  PIC 99.
00042          01  WS-C                  PIC X.
00043          01  WS-NOP                PIC 9.
00044          01  BW.
00045              05  BW-N              PIC 9(4) COMP.
00046          01  BW-X REDEFINES BW.
00047              05  FILLER            PIC X.
00048              05  BW-L              PIC X.
00049          01  HEX-DATA              PIC X(16) VALUE '0123456789ABCDEF'.
00050          01  HEX-TABLE REDEFINES HEX-DATA.
00051              05  HEXDIG            PIC X OCCURS 16 TIMES.
00052          01  RES-LINE.
00053              05  FILLER            PIC X(4) VALUE 'QRY '.
00054              05  RL-NAME           PIC X(8).   2


00055              05  FILLER            PIC X(5) VALUE ' LEN='.
00056              05  RL-LEN            PIC 9(4).
00057              05  FILLER            PIC X(3) VALUE ' C='.
00058              05  RL-C              PIC 9.
00059              05  FILLER            PIC X(3) VALUE ' H='.
00060              05  RL-H              PIC 9.
00061              05  FILLER            PIC X(4) VALUE ' GE='.
00062              05  RL-GE             PIC 9.
00063          PROCEDURE DIVISION.
00064          MAIN-PARA.
00065              OPEN INPUT CARD-FILE.
00066              MOVE 0 TO Q-LEN.
00067              PERFORM READ-CARD THRU READ-CARD-EXIT UNTIL WS-EOF = 1.
00068              IF CUR-NAME NOT = SPACES
00069                  PERFORM EVAL-REPLY.
00070              CLOSE CARD-FILE.
00071              DISPLAY 'QRY TEST END'.
00072              STOP RUN.
00073          READ-CARD.
00074              READ CARD-FILE INTO WS-CARD
00075                  AT END MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
00076                  GO TO READ-CARD-EXIT.
00077              IF CD-NAME NOT = CUR-NAME AND CUR-NAME NOT = SPACES
00078                  PERFORM EVAL-REPLY.
00079              IF CD-NAME NOT = CUR-NAME
00080                  MOVE CD-NAME TO CUR-NAME
00081                  MOVE 0 TO Q-LEN
00082                  MOVE SPACES TO Q-AREA.
00083              MOVE 1 TO WS-K.
00084              PERFORM ADD-BYTE UNTIL WS-K > 63.
00085          READ-CARD-EXIT.
00086              EXIT.
00087          ADD-BYTE.
00088              MOVE CD-HEX (WS-K) TO WS-C.
00089              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00090              IF WS-C NOT = SPACE
00091                  PERFORM HEX-PAIR.
00092              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00093          HEX-PAIR.
00094              PERFORM DIGIT-VAL.
00095              MOVE WS-D TO WS-HV.
00096              MOVE CD-HEX (WS-K) TO WS-C.
00097              PERFORM DIGIT-VAL.
00098              MOVE WS-D TO WS-LV.
00099              COMPUTE BW-N = WS-HV * 16 + WS-LV.
00100              ADD 1 TO Q-LEN.
00101              MOVE BW-L TO Q-CH (Q-LEN).
00102          DIGIT-VAL.
00103              MOVE 1 TO WS-D.
00104              PERFORM NEXT-DIGIT UNTIL WS-D > 16
00105                  OR HEXDIG (WS-D) = WS-C.
00106              SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-D.
00107          NEXT-DIGIT.
00108              ADD 1 TO WS-D.
00109          EVAL-REPLY.
00110              CALL 'PACQRY' USING Q-AREA Q-LEN Q-OUT.
00111              MOVE CUR-NAME TO RL-NAME.   3


00112              MOVE Q-LEN TO RL-LEN.
00113              MOVE QO-COLOUR TO RL-C.
00114              MOVE QO-HILITE TO RL-H.
00115              MOVE QO-GE TO RL-GE.
00116              DISPLAY RES-LINE.   4

00001         * PACQRY : MVS-G4 CAPABILITY PARSING (PURE: NO I/O, NO TERMINAL).
00002         * CALL 'PACQRY' USING QRY-AREA QRY-LEN QRY-OUT. THE AREA HOLDS A
00003         * READ PARTITION QUERY REPLY AS RECEIVED BY PACPLAT (AID X'88'
00004         * + STRUCTURED FIELDS: LENGTH(2), X'81', QCODE, DATA). OUT:
00005         *   QO-COLOUR 1 = QCODE X'86' (MVS-G1), QO-HILITE 1 = QCODE X'87'
00006         *   (MVS-G2), QO-GE 1 = QCODE X'85' WITH FLAG X'80' (GE) AND X'02'
00007         *   (CGCSGID PRESENT) AND A SET WHOSE CODE PAGE IS 310 (APL).
00008         * THE G1/G2 DECISIONS WERE MOVED HERE FROM PACPLAT UNCHANGED.
00009          IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
00010          PROGRAM-ID. PACQRY.
00011          ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
00012          CONFIGURATION SECTION.
00013          SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00014          OBJECT-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00015          DATA DIVISION.
00016          WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
00017          01  HEXW.
00018              05  HX-Z              PIC X VALUE LOW-VALUE.
00019              05  HX-B              PIC X.
00020          01  HEXN REDEFINES HEXW   PIC 9(4) COMP.
00021          01  WS-K                  PIC 9(4).
00022          01  WS-P                  PIC 9(4).
00023          01  WS-V                  PIC 9(4).
00024          01  WS-L                  PIC 9(4).
00025          01  WS-ID                 PIC 9(4).
00026          01  WS-QC                 PIC 9(4).
00027          01  WS-LIM                PIC 9(4).
00028          01  WS-END                PIC 9(4).
00029          01  WS-D                  PIC 9(4).
00030          01  WS-DL                 PIC 9(4).
00031          01  WS-F1                 PIC 9(4).
00032          01  WS-Q                  PIC 9(4).
00033          01  WS-R                  PIC 9(4).
00034          01  WS-CP                 PIC 9(4).
00035          01  WS-STOP               PIC 9.
00036          01  WS-DSTOP              PIC 9.
00037          01  WS-NOP                PIC 9.
00038          LINKAGE SECTION.
00039          01  QRY-AREA.
00040              05  QRY-CH            PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00041          01  QRY-LEN               PIC S9(4) COMP.
00042          01  QRY-OUT.
00043              05  QO-COLOUR         PIC 9.
00044              05  QO-HILITE         PIC 9.
00045              05  QO-GE             PIC 9.
00046          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING QRY-AREA QRY-LEN QRY-OUT.
00047          MAIN-PARA.
00048              MOVE 0 TO QO-COLOUR.
00049              MOVE 0 TO QO-HILITE.
00050              MOVE 0 TO QO-GE.
00051              PERFORM FIND-CAPS THRU FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00052              GOBACK.
00053          FIND-CAPS.
00054         * QUERY REPLY = AID X'88' (136) + STRUCTURED FIELDS: LENGTH(2),   2


00055         * X'81' (129), QCODE. COLOUR SUPPORT = QCODE X'86' (134).
00056              IF QRY-LEN < 1
00057                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00058              MOVE 1 TO WS-K.
00059              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00060              IF WS-V NOT = 136
00061                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00062              MOVE 2 TO WS-P.
00063              MOVE 0 TO WS-STOP.
00064              PERFORM NEXT-SF THRU NEXT-SF-EXIT UNTIL WS-STOP = 1.
00065          FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00066              EXIT.
00067          NEXT-SF.
00068              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-P + 3.
00069              IF WS-LIM > QRY-LEN
00070                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00071                  GO TO NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00072              MOVE WS-P TO WS-K.
00073              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00074              COMPUTE WS-L = WS-V * 256.
00075              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00076              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00077              ADD WS-V TO WS-L.
00078              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00079              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00080              MOVE WS-V TO WS-ID.
00081              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00082              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00083              MOVE WS-V TO WS-QC.
00084              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 134
00085                  MOVE 1 TO QO-COLOUR.
00086              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 135
00087                  MOVE 1 TO QO-HILITE.
00088              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 133 AND WS-L > 13
00089                  PERFORM CHAR-SETS THRU CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00090              IF WS-L < 4
00091                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00092              ELSE
00093                  ADD WS-L TO WS-P.
00094          NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00095              EXIT.
00096          CHAR-SETS.
00097         * X'85': FLAGS1 AT +4, DESCRIPTOR LENGTH (DL) AT +12, DESCRIPTORS
00098         * FROM +13 TO THE END OF THE FIELD; THE CGCSGID IS THE LAST FOUR
00099         * BYTES OF A DESCRIPTOR, ITS LAST TWO = CODE PAGE (310 = X'0136').
00100              COMPUTE WS-END = WS-P + WS-L - 1.
00101              IF WS-END > QRY-LEN
00102                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00103              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 4.
00104              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00105              MOVE WS-V TO WS-F1.
00106              IF WS-F1 < 128
00107                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00108              DIVIDE WS-F1 BY 4 GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-R.
00109              IF WS-R < 2
00110                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00111              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 12.   3


00112              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00113              MOVE WS-V TO WS-DL.
00114              IF WS-DL < 4
00115                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00116              COMPUTE WS-D = WS-P + 13.
00117              MOVE 0 TO WS-DSTOP.
00118              PERFORM NEXT-DESC UNTIL WS-DSTOP = 1.
00119          CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00120              EXIT.
00121          NEXT-DESC.
00122              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-D + WS-DL - 1.
00123              IF WS-LIM > WS-END
00124                  MOVE 1 TO WS-DSTOP.
00125              IF WS-DSTOP = 0
00126                  PERFORM DESC-CP.
00127              ADD WS-DL TO WS-D.
00128          DESC-CP.
00129              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-LIM - 1.
00130              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00131              COMPUTE WS-CP = WS-V * 256.
00132              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00133              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00134              ADD WS-V TO WS-CP.
00135              IF WS-CP = 310
00136                  MOVE 1 TO QO-GE.
00137              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00138          BYTE-VAL.
00139              MOVE QRY-CH (WS-K) TO HX-B.
00140              MOVE HEXN TO WS-V.   4
